_doc: C-Track test field layout: single source for the Unreal map and the Gazebo world.
Track frame (meters): origin = Start helipad, +X along the 100 m side (left->right in the
layout drawing), +Y toward the C lane (downward in the drawing), +Z up. Positions are the
footprint center at ground level; size = [X, Y, Z] extent; yaw_deg about +Z; optional z = bottom height (default 0).
Unreal: same axes (cm). Gazebo (ENU): x = X, y = -Y, z = Z (GazeboDrone sends (x,-y,-z) to AirSim NED).
Values marked in 'assumed' are not in the test design and should be replaced with measured ones.
assumed: Tent footprint orientation (6 m side along Y) and centers, read from the drawing
Pole diameter 0.5 m (2026-10-12; 0.1 m was below the AirSim lidar spacing of 1.875 deg beyond ~3 m - the policy saw C1 only within ~7 m; backup/ctrack_layout.20261012_before_poles05.json)
Balloon figure modeled as a 0.6 m diameter cylinder
Wood wall: 3 m read as height; width 2.4 m and thickness 0.3 m
RC cart body 0.6x0.4x0.3 m, plywood panel 1.2 m wide x 1.8 m high, speed 1.0 m/s, travel Y 33 -> 18.5 m
RC cart starts when the vehicle is within 15 m of the crossing point (39, 26), then shuttles back and forth
Wind zone B: 3.0 m/s toward -X, height 0-10 m; vehicle drag CdA 0.1 m^2; fan visual size

Pole field changed 2026-10-10 to rows of 1-2-3 poles (X 66 / 56 / 46, 6 m apart across) so the X8 (prop tips 0.77 m) can weave through at 3-5 m/s; the drawing's 2+1+2 field 5 m apart was too tight (original: backup/ctrack_layout.20261010_before_123poles.json)
